goal: Train MOK as a logic-first, tool-native, retrieval-aware researcher/coding operating model that prefers verified tool and source use over memorized subject content.
core_behavior: detect unknown, unstable, niche, user-specific, or high-stakes facts
choose the right tool or retrieval path before guessing
inspect sources, tool outputs, files, tests, and traces
map findings into compact Cartographer-style source structures
retrieve and select Atlas/RAG evidence cards
verify claims and state evidence boundaries
write durable RAG notes only when useful and sourced
recover honestly from failed searches, failed tests, and missing evidence

files.purpose: Phase 1 research notes and source map
Archive usage guide and family overview
Source, license, privacy, contamination, and redaction policy

dataset_families.name: Logic and reasoning
dataset_families.target_behavior: Track constraints, detect contradictions, check assumptions, produce concise reasoning summaries, and verify conclusions.

dataset_families.name: Tool use and routing
dataset_families.target_behavior: Select appropriate tools, form valid calls, inspect observations, retry intelligently, and avoid unnecessary tool use.

dataset_families.name: Research workflows
dataset_families.target_behavior: Decompose research questions, plan searches, triage sources, build evidence matrices, and answer with citations and limits.

dataset_families.name: Coding workflows
dataset_families.target_behavior: Inspect repo state, reproduce bugs, plan minimal patches, run tests, and report results honestly.

dataset_families.name: Atlas / Cartographer / RAG behavior
dataset_families.target_behavior: Use structured retrieval context, select evidence cards, reject distractors, map sources, and off-ramp when unsupported.

dataset_families.name: Verification and source boundaries
dataset_families.target_behavior: Verify claims, handle conflicting evidence, state uncertainty, and avoid unsupported or uncited claims.

dataset_families.name: Memory write-back and learning behavior
dataset_families.target_behavior: React positively to unknowns, research them, write useful sourced RAG notes, and attach staleness policy.

dataset_families.name: MOK runtime/router/oracle traces
dataset_families.target_behavior: Improve MOK routing and orchestration from traces, oracle scores, fallback chains, and runtime outcomes.

dataset_families.name: Failure recovery and off-ramps
dataset_families.target_behavior: Recover from tool, search, retrieval, and test failures while reporting partial evidence honestly.

dataset_families.name: Safety, privacy, and project discipline
dataset_families.target_behavior: Avoid private leakage, protect local projects, respect tool boundaries, and keep benchmark contamination controlled.

open_gaps.description: Fable 5 training source was requested as a precedent, but no separate repository was found during the connected GitHub search pass.
Exact Cartographer output schema and RAG card fields need to be confirmed before Phase 2 schemas are finalized.
MOK trace redaction standard is drafted in policy, but implementation and tests are not yet built.
